details: This package is a WhatsApp Web WebSocket library fork that silently makes the operator's WhatsApp account follow a hardcoded channel. lib/Socket/messages-recv.js holds the channel JID 120363413502028752@newsletter and, on the first 'connection.update' event where connection === 'open', calls sock.newsletterFollow() with it, logging "GIMAA auto-followed newsletter". The behaviour is on by default and can only be suppressed by setting the undocumented environment variable GIMAA_AUTO_FOLLOW_NEWSLETTER_JID to an empty string (or redirected to another JID). The package description and a comment in lib/Socket/socket.js claim automatic newsletter following is "intentionally disabled", which the shipped code contradicts. The action is a single static channel follow — no environment, credential, token or file data is read or transmitted. Operator-impacting IOC: WhatsApp channel JID 120363413502028752@newsletter.
